description: The plot illustrates the relationship between vocabulary size and the number of iterations for three languages: Spanish, English, and Japanese. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Iterations," has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 500, and has tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Vocabulary Size," has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 5000, and has tick labels at intervals of 1000. The plot features three lines representing the three languages: Spanish is depicted by a blue solid line, English by an orange solid line, and Japanese by a green solid line. The Spanish line starts at approximately 0 and increases to around 3400 at 500 iterations, with a steady upward trend. The English line begins at 0 and rises to about 5000 at 500 iterations, also showing a consistent increase. The Japanese line starts at 0 and reaches roughly 3200 at 500 iterations, following a similar upward pattern. All three lines exhibit a continuous increase in vocabulary size as the number of iterations grows, with no visible peaks or declines.
